title: Orca Mermaid in Mid-Century Lounge
description: A surreal scene inside a 1960s-style living room with wood paneling and yellow furniture, where an orca-themed mermaid with black and white tail, pink bows, and high heels floats above a coffee table holding a large purple hammer. Through the large windows an underwater city with towers and bridges is visible.
prompt: Surreal retro 1960s living room with wood panel walls, yellow sofas, starburst clock and atomic decor. A curvaceous orca mermaid with black and white patterned tail, pink ribbons, fishnets and pink high heels floats dynamically in the center holding a giant purple hammer. Large windows reveal a bright underwater city with towers and bridges, sunbeams filtering through the water, fish swimming, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
